mechanism: Methotrexate impairs intestinal absorption and metabolism of vitamin D, potentially leading to deficiency; vitamin D supplementation may help mitigate methotrexate-induced bone loss and improve calcium homeostasis.
action: Monitor vitamin D levels in patients on chronic methotrexate therapy and supplement cholecalciferol as needed to maintain adequate levels (target 25-OH vitamin D >30 ng/mL) to prevent osteoporosis and secondary hyperparathyroidism.
